value.description: Value is the balance of the dependency, 1 to 10.

min.description: Min is the policy's min_balance, 1 to 10.

Balance.description: Balance is the coupling number of a dependency, printed as "Value/10 (min Min)".

from.description:
From is the module of the first argument, or the argument as given
when it is in no module.

to.description:
To is the module or library of the second argument, or the argument as
given when it is in no module.

rule.description: Rule is the rule that decides a no or an unknown.

what.description: What says why the answer is not yes.

why.description: Why is the reason the rule exists.

instead.description: Instead is what the owner says to do, when the rule has it.

balance.description: Balance is the balance the dependency would have.

next.description: Next is the one step to take, when the answer is not yes.

policy.description: Policy names the policy that gave the answer.

head.description: Head is the HEAD commit when the question was asked.

date.description: Date is the date of the answer (YYYY-MM-DD).

engine.description: Engine is the version of the archfit build that answered.

CanAnswer.description: CanAnswer is the answer of `archfit can <from> <to>`: may this dependency or library be used.

path.description:
Path is the file, relative to the repository root. An error of the
policy itself, such as an expired exception, has the path .archfit.yaml.

line.description: Line is the line in Path. Absent for an error of the policy file.

rule.description:
Rule is the rule id: a built-in rule (graph, coupling, duplication,
cycle, layers, unowned), a custom rule id, or "exception" for an
exception past its date.

why.description: Why is the reason the rule exists.

instead.description: Instead is what the owner says to do, when the rule has it.

balance.description:
Balance is the balance of the dependency, when the rule is about
coupling.

next.description: Next is the one step to take.

from.description: From is the module the dependency starts in.

to.description:
To is the module the dependency reaches, or the library for an only
rule.

key.description:
Key identifies the error: its rule, modules, and symbol or literal.
An expired exception is keyed by "exception", the rule it covers and
its modules, so it never shares a key with an error of that rule.
Equal keys name the same error in two results of one engine version.
Consumers compare keys and do not parse them.

from_change.description:
FromChange is true when the change added the error. It is false for
an expired exception listed because its date has passed, which the
change did not add to.

exception.description:
Exception names the policy exception that has expired. Set only when
Rule is "exception".

Error.description: Error is one place where the change breaks a rule.

rule.description: Rule is the rule the exception covers.

expires.description: Expires is the date the exception ended (YYYY-MM-DD).

Exception.description: Exception identifies an exception of the policy by its rule; From and To of the error hold its modules.

kind.description: Kind is the kind of step.

text.description:
Text is the step as the record prints it: "fix the code", a command, or
"wait for an owner: #431".

note.description:
Note is a short hint the record prints in parentheses after Text, such
as "do not copy the code".

Next.description: Next is the one step a record names.

path.description: Path is the policy file, relative to the repository root.

digest.description: Digest is "sha256:" and the hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes.

protected.description: Protected is true when a workflow runs the check on pull requests.

differs.description: Differs is true when the local policy differs from the target's.

target.description:
Target is the ref the policy was compared with, such as origin/main.
Absent when no comparison was made.

Policy.description: Policy names the policy that judged a change.

status.description: The status of the change. The App sets waiting; the engine never emits it.

summary.description:
Summary is the status line of the record, such as
"archfit: fail, 1 error (not from this change)".

errors.description:
Errors are the errors of the change, in record order. An expired
exception is listed for every change, whether or not the change added
to it.

unknown.description: Unknown are the reasons for an unknown status, in record order.

policy.description: Policy names the policy that judged the change.

base.description: Base is the merge-base commit. Absent when there is no merge base.

head.description: Head is the HEAD commit of the checked tree.

date.description:
Date is the date the exceptions were judged on (YYYY-MM-DD). It is an
input: the same tree, policy, engine and date give the same result.

engine.description: Engine is the version of the archfit build that produced the result.

Result.description: Result is the verdict of `archfit check` for one change.

path.description: Path is the file the reason is about, when there is one.

line.description: Line is the line in Path, when there is one.

cause.description: Cause is what is missing or wrong.

what.description: What says what is missing or wrong.

why.description: Why is the reason this stops the verdict.

next.description: Next is the one step that restores a verdict.

Unknown.description: Unknown is one reason the check gave no verdict.

description: The result of archfit check (schema archfit.result.v1) or the answer of archfit can (schema archfit.can.v1).
